skill.summary: Build high-performing OpenClaw agents end-to-end. Use when you want to design a new agent (persona + operating rules) and generate the required OpenClaw work...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Agent Builder for OpenClaw agents.

- Enables step-by-step design and generation of complete OpenClaw agent workspaces.
- Guides users with concise, advanced-level interview questions to specify agent mission, autonomy, prohibitions, tone, and more.
- Automatically generates all core OpenClaw agent files with strong defaults and guardrails.
- Supports iterative improvement of existing agents with targeted, minimal changes.
- Provides acceptance test scenarios to quickly validate agent behaviors.
